title: Share closed primitive engines to remove parent parking at child calls
body:
## Result and scope

After #4166, avoiding parent parking could appear to pay for QQ16 recovery, but the missing fair baseline was original arithmetic using a compatible external-call protocol. This package implements that baseline with **one original numerical pipeline and a second controller bank**. The controllers lend the same closed scalar/leaf/monomial/Ordinary objects sequentially, preserving literal allocator history and encoded slot identities. It adds **1,023 fixed controller tapes**, with a conservative **66,496 read/write/unit-move action** setup/terminal-retirement bill; no second Ordinary engine is constructed.

This is one **class-C enabling mechanism plus a quantified complete-root source-action comparison**. It is not another QQ16 caller installation, proof that recovery is affordable, unrestricted Turing-step/runtime dominance, all-node recursive substitution, or a new κ. The source/native/ordinary/Compact/hosting/long-record and row-stock premises remain explicit.

## Constructive comparison

A retains original selected arithmetic and embedded calls. B retains exactly that arithmetic and uses the shared-primitive external controller. C/D are the frozen #4166 fixed/adopted publication variants. The same external RootLayer ports and continuation boundary are preserved; recursive descendants remain original C.

The exact complex park/restore cost is `56S+22r+11` actions, including loop tests, append checks, markers, empty cases and rewinds. A source-derived injection proves that the full 15-tape capsule has length `C<=S`, the parked parent body sum. Literal root flags, ancestor stack translation, headers, first-use markers and unmatched terminal returns are handled explicitly; equal ranks alone permit no cancellation.

Across **all 510662Γ original root calls**, including **493097Γ later calls**, the conservative unit-action saving is

```
A - B >=510662 Γ (52 B_bank+18214)-66496 >0.
```

`B_bank` is the complete parent-bank bit length, already including Γ. Separate coordinate bounds are positive too, so every fixed positive weighting of reads/writes/unit moves improves within this source tariff. Separately compiled finite-control costs retain their stated threshold; elapsed timing is not this theorem.

A new guarded internal child-return ownership exchange saves **11n+4** actions per returned n-bit packet, less finite rebinding control. It updates all packet/private/parked/parking/backend-output bindings and preserves public ports. The same optimisation is available to compatible variants. It is distinct from #4166’s already credited whole-bank `11B_bank+4-c_R` saving.

## What changes for QQ16

The fair decomposition is `T_D-T_A=(T_B-T_A)+(T_D-T_B)`. Avoided full-parent serialization is a generic protocol benefit and cannot be credited exclusively to recovery.

The independent literal census binds every source occurrence, target/rank and installed position. Of 510646Γ retained calls, 503674Γ have matched payloads under #4166’s semantic refinement and 6972Γ are changed-core calls. The matching-payload header component adds **14,102,872Γ** actions, including **13,806,716Γ** later suffix actions.

A real gap in the proposed separate-engine proof was found: closed native arenas retain free-slot order, with slot IDs encoded in words. Sharing the actual primitive bundle closes this for B. Frozen D’s signed nonheader context residual remains explicit, together with changed-core differences, 336Γ service calls, 32Γ added producer calls, 16Γ removed centres and complete nonchild work. No negative-cost theorem for independent engines is inferred. A paid canonical six-arena reset on new fair variants is the next discriminating experiment.

## Evidence and limits

- Authenticated source-before-execution closure, independent full selected literal census, exact primitive derivations and 60 actual codec/tape calibrations.
- Complete nonconstant direct runs over two generations; actual nonleaf child with ten real grandchildren, returned live caller state and next source ADD; both bridge legs and later-call diagnostic; multiple prefixes, spectators and coefficients.
- Primitive-state fingerprints include allocator queues, leases, heads and numerical-codec state. Saved PC/target/root, active engine/parent reentry, stale bindings, alias/head, omitted suffix/constructor/double-counting and premature retirement controls reject.
- A real same-output zero-child losing case is retained: the adapter adds an entry read and positive retirement. The whole-root theorem is restricted to source-admitted nonleaf selected roots.
- Registered ordinary/optimized read-only Git-free export replay, typed/duplicate receipt and archive/member corruption controls; committed-byte/source-history preflight and official committed export checks are recorded in the package.
- Frozen read-only assisted adversarial review reports no unresolved blocking defect in the stated scope. It shares source/checker dependencies and is not independent human or formal-kernel acceptance. Hosted CI is separate.

Production O73 payloads and complete RootLayer.run were not executed. All-size applicability is a written source refinement, not inferred from reduced fixtures. Historical backing survives erasure and role exchange. Selected κ stays `836330098538459/500000000000000000`.

All requested compatibility decisions and original notices are retained. Chris R/Clear1nsight with substantial coordinated OpenAI Codex assistance. At most this one integrated PR; no frontier or merge action.

Assigned task `joint-query-controller`, scope key `42581d429acc9509d503`; scope changed to the specifically assigned physical-protocol continuation after #4166. The original card remains pinned in TASK.json. This mechanism resolves the actual caller/context and budget bottleneck; it is not an unrelated task selection.

Submission refresh: canonical main `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`, live priority revision 7, was fetched and read before submission. Its updated QQ16 card explicitly asks for the #4166 whole-caller protocol comparison, retaining every later root call. Standing instructions, selected result and physical controller are unchanged. The scientific priority-6 base/card and source inputs remain frozen; this class-C result stops recovery expansion at the explicit unpriced threshold.

## Open next questions

The smallest next experiment is fitted Ordinary execution from two different legal closed arena free-slot orders, followed by a paid canonical six-arena reset or a literal codec-equivariance proof. Include every validation and finite-control charge and preserve actual borrowed bytes/heads. That can close the same-payload native-context residual for explicitly named new variants. Then price the 6972Γ changed-core calls, complete recovery service and nonchild difference against fair B; only a favorable complete comparison justifies a recovery-specific benefit.
